title: [Main][ALL-E] Item Attributes (Decimal): Unable to Enter 0 After Clearing the Attribute Value to blank
summary: Fixed decimal item attribute lookup to correctly distinguish between blank and zero values, allowing users to save 0 as an attribute value after clearing it.
key_points: Decimal item attribute lookup was incorrectly selecting blank records when searching for numeric 0
Blank attribute records have a default numeric value of 0, causing the collision
Lookup now excludes blank attribute values when searching for nonblank decimal values
Regression tests added to verify blank-versus-zero lookup and zero persistence across page reopens
quote: Exclude blank attribute values when looking up a nonblank decimal value.
